identity.title: Chemical Imaging of the CO Snow Line in the HD 163296 Disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA Cycle 1 observations of the N 2 H [+] J = 3 − 2 and DCO [+] J = 4 − 3 emission lines toward the disk around the Herbig Ae star HD 163296

evidence.quote: the disk around HD 163296 at a distance of ∼122 pc, the target of this study

question.value: Where is the CO snow line in the HD 163296 disk, and how well do N2H+, DCO+ and C18O trace it?

evidence.quote: The aim is to determine the CO snow line location using observations of N 2 H [+] emission.
(ALMA Cycle 1 project 2012.1.00681.S)
ALMA science verification (SV) program 2011.0.00010.SV

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Four SPWs: N2H+ 3-2, DCO+ 4-3, one with an H2CO line, one continuum-only

evidence.quote: The correlator was configured to observe four spectral windows (SPWs)

Rest frequency (GHz) 219.560 220.399

carried out with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) on 21 May 2014

evidence.quote: We adopt the density and temperature disk structure from Qi et al. (2011)

method.value: CASA reduction, continuum self-cal from CASA guide, continuum subtraction in uv

evidence.quote: We applied the continuum self-calibration

analysis_steps.goal: Fit N2H+ and DCO+ abundance profiles

method.value: Parametric column density power law with R_in, R_out, N100, p; chi2 on complex visibilities with RATRAN

evidence.quote: The best-fit parameter estimates are obtained by minimizing χ [2], the weighted residual of the complex visibilities

key_parameters.value: Vertical boundaries σs,σm fixed to 1, 32; R_out fixed at 500 AU for N2H+

evidence.quote: We fix the vertical boundary values σ s, σ m to 1, 32, respectively

assumptions.value: Disk inclination ~44 deg; Qi et al. 2011 disk structure

evidence.quote: disk inclination at around 44 [◦], see Qi et al. 2011
Errors within 3σ.

validation.value: Residual images show no emission above 3σ

evidence.quote: the residual image shows no significant emission above the 3σ level

analysis_steps.goal: Fit C18O with freeze-out temperature and depletion

method.value: Same framework with T_CO and F_CO free, σs fixed at 0.79

evidence.quote: with both the CO freeze-out temperature (T CO ) and the CO freeze-out fraction (depletion factor; F CO ) as free parameters
assuming an abundance ratio of CO/C [18] O=550

validation.value: Compared with original Qi et al. 2011 model; fit imperfect in inner disk

evidence.quote: The fit is not perfect, however
The visibility data were reduced and calibrated in CASA 4.2.
We use the two-dimensional Monte Carlo software RATRAN
We find R in =90 [+8] −6 [AU.]
the N 2 H [+] column density is 2.6±0.1 ×10 [11] cm [−][2] at 100 AU
inner abundance boundary at 40 [+6] −3 [AU]
We find a best-fit T CO = 25 − 26 K, which occurs at a radius of 85–90 AU
the depletion factor is about 5

findings_qualitative.value: 13CO-based 155 AU snow line reflects opacity transition, not a CO drop

evidence.quote: rapid changes in line opacities can masquerade as snow lines

claims.hypothesis: N2H+ inner ring edge traces the CO snow line
claims.experiment: Visibility-domain model fit of N2H+ and C18O
claims.finding: N2H+ is a robust CO snow line tracer

evidence.quote: Thus N 2 H [+] appears to be a robust tracer of the midplane CO snow line.

claims.hypothesis: DCO+ edges coincide with the CO snow line

evidence.quote: neither the inner nor the outer radius coincides with the CO snow line location of 90 AU

claims.hypothesis: CO freeze-out temperature is the same across disks
claims.experiment: Compare 25 K to TW Hya 17 K

evidence.quote: CO freezes out at a higher temperature in the disk around HD 163296 (25 vs. 17 K in the TW Hya disk)

limitations_admitted.value: Data give no N2H+ constraints beyond a few hundred AU; C18O fit imperfect in inner disk

evidence.quote: the data provides no constraints on the N 2 H [+] beyond a few hundred AU due to a lack of sensitivity

referee_caveats_inferred: Results depend on the adopted Qi et al. 2011 temperature structure
Parametric abundance profile and fixed vertical boundaries
Conversion of radius to temperature is model-dependent

missing_for_reproduction: Disk model parameters (in Qi et al. 2011)
reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and clear model parameterization, but imaging and fitting details and the disk model are external.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Requires RATRAN fitting using external disk model; recipe incomplete.
